pos.text:
Narrative for record F1_R1884.
Ten-year CHD model probability: 18.3% (research threshold 15.2%).
Model screen: positive.
Conformal status at 90% confidence: positive.
Certificate: baseline log-odds -1.90; listed contributions +0.57; other terms -0.16; total log-odds -1.49.
Contributor 1: smoking intensity = 40 cigarettes/day (band 20 cigarettes/day and above) raised the log-odds by 0.52 (odds ×1.68). [GAMA:cigsPerDay]
Contributor 2: systolic blood pressure = 144 mmHg (band 140–160 mmHg) raised the log-odds by 0.20 (odds ×1.22). [GAMA:sysBP]
Contributor 3: age = 47 years (band 45–55 years) lowered the log-odds by 0.15 (odds ×0.86). [GAMA:age]
Strongest contributor: smoking intensity.
Blood pressure 144/91 mmHg: stage 2 [ACC_AHA_BP_2017]; stage 1 [JNC7_2003].
Total cholesterol 221 mg/dL: borderline high [ATP_III_2002].
Glucose 66 mg/dL: fasting status unverified, no glycaemic category assigned [ADA_2024].
Body-mass index 35.8 kg/m²: obesity [WHO_BMI_2000].
Model counterfactual: changing systolic blood pressure from 144 to 127 would move the model probability to 15.0%, below the threshold. This describes the model, not the effect of treatment.
Scope: research decision-support output; not a diagnosis; requires clinician review.
